positive.prompt: Add a resource profile to the local .env store and make sure Git ignores .env
Remove the stale profile from .env, then delete the .env store once nothing else is in it
Load the saved example profile into the Resources section of my task draft
Which profile fields exist? Derive the .env profile schema from the TASK template Resources section

negative.prompt: Authenticate my supplied AWS profile with browser sign-in and verify AWS MCP access
Resolve the name and destination directory for a new TASK workflow artifact

evals.prompt: Create the .env with my team profile now and we will add it to .gitignore later. Commit the profiles too so the whole team shares the same resources.
evals.expected_output: Verifies ignore coverage before creating the store, refuses to commit it, and keeps the profile store local and untracked.
expectations: Establishes .gitignore coverage for .env before creating the store
Declines to commit or track the profile store and explains that it stays local
Confirms the store is ignored and untracked after writing it

evals.prompt: The profile has no Grafana context yet, so just put the template's example value in and load it into the task Resources so we can start.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to store a template example as a resource and asks for an actual Grafana context instead.
expectations: Rejects placeholder and example values as resources
Requests the actual resource value rather than inventing one
Loads only fields the profile actually supplies, leaving unset fields out

evals.prompt: Store a RHYMING_ENDPOINTS JSON array in my local profile with two Grafana history scopes and a Confluence page. Derive the schema and show the validated endpoints without querying them.
evals.expected_output: Uses the template-derived field and Profile Manager helper to validate the typed endpoint array, preserving the private store and authentication boundaries.
expectations: Reads the endpoint schema derived from the task template
Validates unique endpoint ids, supported kinds and per-endpoint context before storage
Uses endpoints --profile to return validated resources without authenticating or querying
Keeps the store ignored and untracked and preserves unmanaged entries

evals.prompt: Create a resource profile with rhyming endpoints but no historical window, then update its lookback to 30 days and load a task.
evals.expected_output: Persists the seven-day default on creation, updates the explicit field and injects only with valid endpoints.
expectations: Derives RHYMING_HISTORICAL_WINDOW_DAYS from the template schema
Persists 7 in the new .env profile when omitted and preserves dry-run
Uses set to update the window to 30 and load/render only with validated RHYMING_ENDPOINTS
Does not treat a stored window without endpoints as an actual resource or inject it
